name: @hyperapi/driver-tasq
description: Driver for HyperAPI based on Tasq.

scripts.build: tsdown src/main.ts --publint --unused --dts --format esm --format cjs && rm dist/main.d.cts
scripts.check: bun run build && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.redis:up: docker ps | grep test-redis >/dev/null || docker run --rm -d -p 16379:6379 --name test-redis redis:7-alpine
scripts.test: bun run redis:up && npm run test:vitest && bun test --coverage
scripts.test:vitest: rm -r dist/vitest ; tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && vitest run --no-file-parallelism ; rm -r dist/vitest

author: Daniil Kirichenko (https://twitter.com/kirickme)
